subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) The astrologer was taken to the place of executing and than the king asked, 'How long would you live?' (b) Once there was a king who was fond of knowing his future from the astrologer. (c) The astrologer told something very unpleasant and at this the king got furious and condemned him to death. SSC English (d) With ready wit he said, 'The stars declare that I'll die only a week before your death! I shall wait to receive your majesty where you have been sending me.' (e) At this the king turned pale and shouted 'Drive this wretch away and let him no come again.' (f) A good astrologer visited the capital of the king. (g) He thought that the king would prove him a liar putting him to death and then he thought for a while for some way of escape. (h) The king wished to know his future from the astrologer and so, the king called him to the palace. R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
